content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often exclude creators in regions like Kenya, leaving them unable to sell digital products effectively. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed to combat these barriers. By leveraging decentralized payment systems, you eliminate reliance on conventional banking and payment processing entities that may reject your business based on geographical limitations. This architecture uses blockchain technology, allowing you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees. Furthermore, the ownership model ensures you retain complete control over your products and customer data. This sovereignty empowers you to engage directly with your audience, fostering trust and ensuring that your business can operate independently of external platforms that often impose restrictive policies.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you dive into deploying your ecommerce infrastructure, ensure you have the essential components in place. First, familiarize yourself with the tools included in the COREMERCH Complete Builder Kit, which provides comprehensive documentation and templates for successful deployment. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your site, as well as an order management solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for tracking sales. Additionally, you should set up a NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions seamlessly. Finally, prepare your digital products, such as ebooks, ensuring they are ready for instant delivery upon purchase. With these components in place, you are well-prepared to deploy your ecommerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To effectively set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will begin by configuring your NOWPayments account. This will enable you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, minimizing transaction costs and enhancing customer access. Next, integrate your payment gateway with your hosting provider, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Afterward, use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to create backend logic that connects orders to product delivery systems. For product delivery, link your preferred storage solution, like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, where your ebooks will be stored and accessible for customers after purchase. Finally, test the entire pipeline by simulating a transaction to confirm everything is functioning as expected. This setup ensures a smooth customer experience from payment initiation to product delivery.
Ownership of your ecommerce infrastructure is your key to independence.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your ecommerce infrastructure is fully set up, you are ready to go live. Launch your website, ensuring that all links work properly and that your products are correctly displayed. Promote your store through social media and digital marketing channels to attract your first customers. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will automatically process the payment and trigger a confirmation webhook. At this point, the order details should be captured in your Google Sheets or Supabase database, while the purchased ebook is delivered from your storage solution. Ensure to monitor the process closely for any issues during this initial transaction. It's crucial to provide a positive experience to build trust and encourage repeat customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is live and you've processed a few transactions successfully, it's time to consider scaling. Begin by analyzing sales data to identify popular products and peak purchasing times. This information will help you optimize your offerings and marketing strategies. Consider expanding your product range or enhancing your website's functionality to improve user experience. You can also explore partnerships with influencers or other creators to reach a broader audience. Additionally, reinvest in your business by upgrading your hosting plans or utilizing advanced features of your payment processor. This growth phase is crucial for establishing a sustainable income stream, allowing you to focus on creating more digital products while ensuring your infrastructure remains robust and efficient.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create accounts on GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting your site. 2. Set up NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. 3. Choose an order management system: Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Prepare your digital products, ensuring they are ready for sale. 5. Integrate payment processing with your hosting service. 6. Link your product storage solution (e.g., Google Drive) to enable delivery. 7. Test your payment and delivery pipeline thoroughly. 8. Promote your store through social media channels to attract customers. 9. Monitor transactions to resolve any issues promptly. 10. Gather customer feedback to improve your service.
Frequently Asked Questions

To set up a NOWPayments account, visit their website and register for an account. Follow the onboarding instructions to link your crypto wallet and configure your payment settings.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins, providing flexibility for your customers.
Can I customize my ecommerce site?
Yes, using the Complete Builder Kit, you can customize your site to reflect your brand identity, including layout, colors, and product listings.
How do I handle customer service?
Customer service can be managed through your order management system. Respond promptly to inquiries and ensure you have clear communication about product delivery.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, the Complete Builder Kit includes 30 days of support after deployment, allowing you to address any issues or questions as you navigate your new ecommerce infrastructure.
